notes:
Locations: offices with more than one location can now see each page for one location or for all of them, and set hours, phone and address per location (Settings → Office → Locations). Offices with a single location see no change.
Analytics → Providers: a new page comparing providers side by side: production, collections, diagnosis presented and accepted, hygiene production per hour, perio diagnosis rate and more. Off until a manager turns it on in Settings → Analytics.
Staff accounts: people are now managed in Settings → People. Add someone by name, invite them by email, and let them set their own PIN. Existing users keep their names and PINs. Sign-in is unchanged.
Includes everything in 0.29.1.
